## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it belongs in Vex.

## Checklist

- [ ] I tested the change locally.
- [ ] I ran `node --check static/app.js` when JavaScript changed.
- [ ] I ran `python3 -m py_compile app.py` when Python changed.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I checked light, dark, and zen themes where relevant.
- [ ] I checked keyboard and mobile behavior where relevant.
- [ ] I preserved guest-mode privacy: unauthenticated workspace data is not persisted.
- [ ] I reviewed Firestore and Storage rules for authentication or data changes.
- [ ] I reviewed SEO, accessibility, and link behavior for user-facing pages.
- [ ] I removed credentials, tokens, private notes, and user data.

## Verification

List commands, browsers, URLs, screenshots, or recordings used to verify the change.

## Screenshots or recordings

Add before/after evidence for visual changes when useful.
